name: Glitch Flicker
description: A flickering glitch with RGB offset, ghosting and scanlines that flashes back to the first clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: frame_rate
params.description: Rate at which the glitch steps through its frames, per unit of progress

params.name: rgb_offset
params.description: Distance between the red and blue channels, as a part of the frame width

params.name: block_amount
params.description: How much the blocks break up the reveal

params.name: ghost_amount
params.description: Strength of the flashes back to the first clip

params.name: red_cyan
params.description: Strength of the red and cyan ghost washes
